rule: Before any corrective action: (1) load the latest scoreboard / last_job / relevant logs, (2) state the observed failure mode in one sentence (e.g. 'ledger mutations exhaust 16-step budget before write_file'), (3) choose the smallest experiment that distinguishes budget vs tool-path vs logic, (4) enqueue that experiment with a new id and clear note. Never shotgun random max-steps increases or re-run the identical failing job. Depth of thought is measured by how cleanly the next job answers the open question.
